segments.text: Yukikaze was originally a princess first-in-line to the throne, but after leaving her kingdom, she became supreme commander of the non-governmental territorial defense militia "Barauhl." She can transform into a dragon. Because she was born into the royal family as a princess, she is quite estranged from the customs of the world, but she is always curious about her surroundings.

Yukikaze is the one who picked up Ichiro, the castaway from another world, in the desert. She haughtily acts as if Ichiro as her personal property, but often gets irritated by him when he won't do what she says.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
ドラゴン族の国「アークジーン」の第一王女であり、無政府領土防衛民兵団「バラウール」にて総大将を務めている。
王族の姫として生まれてきたが故、世俗に疎い面はあるが、好奇心は旺盛。
砂漠で異世界漂流者であるイチローを拾った張本人であり、イチローを自分の所有物として見ているような傲慢さもあるが、なかなか思い通りに動かないイチローにイライラさせられることも多い。
竜族の国・アークジーンの第一王女で、無政府領土防衛民兵団・バラウールの総大将。
王族の姫として生まれてきたがゆえ 世俗に疎い面はあるが、好奇心は旺盛。
時にはお目付け役に隠れて城の外に出て、お忍びで城下町を徘徊するようなことも。
そのため世俗にも順応しつつあるが、金銭感覚においては未だ格差を感じさせる。
一国の王女にしては大食いで短気で喧嘩っ早く、良く言えば快活、悪く言えばガサツ。
主人公の一郎曰く、お姫様らしいのは整った容姿と無駄に尊大な口調ぐらい。
“豪気の姫” と名を馳せるが、好意を持った相手に冷たくされれば本気で落ち込み、
悲しみに触れれば優しく気遣う繊細さを見せるなど、多様な面を持ち合わせている。
砂漠で異世界漂流者である一郎を拾った。
彼を所有物と見ているが、思い通りに動かないのでイライラさせられることも多い。
「命を助けてやったというのになんじゃ その口の利きようは！」

segments.text: A young woman formally known as Aioh Lioh Camylia. She is the vice-representative of the caravan, and is the head of the Lulucarion (Dog) warriors.

As Ailah was taken in by the caravan when she was orphaned during the war ten years ago, she has quite a bit of seniority. She's eager to give up her current position so she can fight on the front lines, something which she's been raring to do.

Currently, due to the relationship between the Dogs and the Dragons, the path to forming an alliance is still long and treacherous. It also appears as if she has some kind of deep personal past with Dragons herself...
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
正式名はアイオ＝ライオ＝カミリア。
キャラバンの副代表で、犬族（ルルカリオン）の戦士達を束ねる立場にある。
昔、戦争で孤児になったところをキャラバンに拾われて１０年、今ではかなりの古参である。
本人はいつも最前線に身を置くことを望んでいるため、今の立場をさっさと誰かに譲りたいと思っている。
現在、犬族と竜族の間に横たわる因縁のため、両者が同盟を組むまでの道のりはかなり険しい。
個人的にも竜族とは過去に浅からぬ因縁があるようだが――。
キャラバンの副代表で、犬族（ルルカリオン）の戦士たちを束ねる立場にある。
昔、戦争で孤児になったところをキャラバンに拾われて10年、今ではかなりの古参。
最前線に立つことを望んでおり、今の立場はさっさと誰かに譲りたいと思っている。

周りからも “戦士” として扱われ、本人もそれが当然だと思っている。
戦闘時は鬼神のような強さを誇るが、日常ではめんどくさがり。
目下の悩みは、代表のファルに 「そろそろいい人は？」 と詰め寄られること。
ファルによる鬼の花嫁修業に怯えている一面も。

A Mermaid girl who lives in Aqulah, the town governed by the Mermaids, who are on the verge of extinction. Since the "Raid on Aqulah" instigated by the Wisla Empire six years ago, she has been working as an attendant for the clan's matriarch.
She has very large breasts and is interested in sex and the like, but her knowledge on the subject is fairly superficial...
Her intelligence is just as one would expect by looking at her, but she is extremely feminine and is very good at all kinds of housework.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page

６年前に起こった、ヴィスラ公国による「アクラー襲撃」以降、族長の下で侍女として働いている。
頭の良さは見た目通りだが、家事全般が得意という女性らしさも持ち合わせている。

6年前のヴィスラ公国による “アクラー襲撃” 以降、族長の侍女として働いている。
艶麗な者の多い人魚族でも一際目立つ外見で、酒場で働いていた頃は船乗りのアイドルだった。
その魅力は他の人魚に羨まれるほどだが、実際は男性経験のない種族的落ちこぼれ。
本人はそのことを気にしており、「自分は人魚に向いていない」 とボヤいているが、
全身から滲み出る無防備さが、男たちの庇護欲を刺激していることに気付いていない。
次期族長候補と目されていた優秀な人魚を母親に持つ有望株でもある。
良い意味で分かりやすく壁を作らない性格で、ムードメーカーを担うことが多い。

「そうだよー？　よーそろーは魔法の言葉！　はい、よーそろー！」

A zombie whose date of birth is unknown. Her appearance may lead some to believe that she is quite young, but in fact, she has lived longer than Ichiro since she became an undead so many years ago. She serves as a slave to the necromancer and zombie master Ozoth, and works with her fellow zombies in the mines.

Compared to them, Reah's body is extremely fresh, meaning she recovers relatively quickly even if all four of her limbs are severed. The symbol of her fate as a slave is branded on her chest, and a ball and chain is attached to her ankle.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
出生不明のゾンビ。見た目は幼いが、ゾンビ化してからは一郎よりも長くこの世界を生きている。ゾンビ使いである死霊魔術師のオゾスに奴隷として従事し、鉱山にて他のゾンビ達と一緒に働いている。
同種のゾンビに比べて鮮度が非常に高い個体で、メンテナスさえあれば四体が切断されても比較的短時間で治療する。奴隷の印として胸には紋章が刻まれ、脚には鉄球がはめられている。

オゾスに行動や思考を制限されているため自身で決断を下すことは無く、
そのため日々の活動に何の疑問も持たず、鉱山で他のゾンビたちと一緒に働いている。

「こちらの手をもぎ取りまして、それを反対側の手で掴めば、背中まで楽勝で届きますですよ？」

segments.text: Carmine (her real given name being Elmarma) hails from a family of nobles who owns land famous for its orange groves. She was the valedictorian of the Copeland Wyvern Royal Academy's twenty-third graduating class.
She's an unlucky girl who always attracts unwanted attention from guys she has no interest in, but who also struggles to get the guys she likes to return her unrequited feelings.
She exposed her vulnerable side to Ichiro when she lost to him in aerial combat training, and ever since, she's had a soft spot for him. Carmine herself won't admit that, however.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
オレンジ農業で有名な領地を統治している貴族の娘で、コープランド王立飛竜学校２３期の首席卒業者。
どうでもいい男には言い寄られるが、好きになった男には好きになってもらえない不遇の女性。
一郎との空戦訓練に出て負かされて精神的に脆い部分が露呈し、それ以来一郎に仄かな好意を寄せるようになるが、当人はそれを認めていない。

segments.text: Carmine's childhood friend and a maid, who has served Carmine's family for generations. She is member of Copeland Wyvern Royal Academy's 23rd graduating class. Despite her timid appearance, she has a strong heart beneath her exterior, and there are times when she speaks in a firm manner to Carmine.
Maureen has a straight-laced and cowardly personality, but that all changes when she drinks alcohol. She also has a habit of twirling her hair with her finger.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page

一見して気弱そうな見た目とは裏腹に芯は強く、カーマインに対して厳しく接することもある。
生真面目で臆病な性格だが、酒を飲むと性格が変わる。

A member of the Royal Wyvern Squadron Preparatory Course's sixth graduating class. Ellen has quite a strange history - before joining the military, she worked as a prostitute.
Despite being a larger dragon, she is highly skilled at hand-to-hand combat and bomb deployment, making her both a competent combat dragon and bombing dragon.
Although she has lost vision in one eye, she fares even better than her fully sighted comrades during aerial combat or bomb raids.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
王立飛竜予科練習生６期卒。
軍に入る前は娼婦であったという変わった経歴の持ち主。
大型竜でありながらも格闘戦能力は高く、同時に爆弾搭載能力も十分にあり、戦闘竜としても爆撃竜としても、双方の任務も十分にこなせる。

The eldest member of the 384th Wyvern Squad, Petra was originally the captain until she suffered a gunshot wound during a previous battle. When she was wounded, she was forced to accept the end of her career as a wyvern, and the fact that she could no longer turn into a dragon. However, she was allowed to become the supreme commander of the Wyvern Squad due to her immense popularity.

With her wings clipped, she was forced to hand over her title as captain to her successor. Since then, it appears she's had a lot on her mind, but she still commands respect among other squad members, even now.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
３８４飛竜隊の最年長にして隊長であったが、以前の戦闘において被弾負傷。
その時の負傷を期にして、飛竜として「あがり」を向かえてしまい、飛竜化出来なくなってしまったが、未だその人望は厚く、その後も飛竜隊の総指揮を執っていた。
翼をもがれ、飛竜隊の隊長としての任を後任に託して以降、思うことも多い様子ではあれど、今なお彼女を尊敬してやまぬ隊員も多い。

一見してどこかおっとりしているようではあるが、王立士官学校にて上級戦術仕官コースを主席で卒業した経歴を持ち、物事に動じない性格や、時にはソウケンをも説教する厳しさがあり、一部の兵達からは神格化されつつある。

segments.text: A vagrant nomad cat. Through various events, she ends up meeting Ichiro and they become acquaintances. Members of the Chaolia (Cats) are known to be quite the chatterboxes, and Curio is one of the worst. Because of this, she often gets nasty looks, even from the other members of her race.

She's a very inquisitive person, and will do whatever it takes to fulfill her desire for knowledge. She puts her thirst for intelligent pleasure first and foremost. Because of this, she is always frustrated, and will eliminate anyone who gets in her way.
Due to her inferior stamina in comparison to the Dogs, she usually can be seen riding an ostrich to get around. Her hobbies are reading and traveling, and most of all, making fun of Ailah.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page

猫族（シャオリア）は話し好きで知られるが、そのなかでも多弁であり、同族にも渋い顔をされることも度々。
好奇心旺盛で、知識欲を満たすためには手段を選ばない知的快楽第一主義者。
そのため常に欲求不満で、自分の邪魔をする者は誰であろうと排除する。

趣味は本を読むことと旅行、なによりアイラをからかうこと。

segments.text: The little representative of the world's greatest caravan, "Laephlarya." She may look fairly young compared to the other members of her race, but let your guard down and you'll pay.
The power to see into the future, the "All-Seeing Eye," was passed down to Fal, making her somewhat of a symbolic figure among the Dogs.

However, she has a bit of a ditzy side, and some treat her as more of a mascot. She is always thinking about what is best for the Dogs, and uses her precognitive abilities for the sake of a better future.
From Frontwing's official Facebook page
世界最大級のキャラバン『レフレリア』の小さな代表。種族的な特徴でかなり若く見えるが、油断すると痛い目を見る。
//晴眼＝せいがん

しかし、すこし間の抜けたところもあり、一部ではマスコット的な扱いを受けることも。
常に犬族のことを考え、よりよい未来のために予知能力を駆使している。

Lyth, the nameless. Her title comes from her being a war orphan, and she was given shelter in the place she was born. Possibly as an the aftereffect of her experience, Lyth can only see the world in monochrome. She has a three-pronged tail, a feature very rare among members of the Dog race.
She may look delicate at first glance, but she is in fact very skilled at espionage activities that make use of her slight physique.

However, she is a bit bothered by the fact that her delicate body isn't fit for child-rearing. Just a bit. Really, just a bit. Her long scarf is her trademark. She's a bit of a bashful girl, and has a tendency to hide her face when she's troubled and doesn't know what to do.

Because of this, Galene is the most vocal when scolding Meltyna's actions, but she is also her best friend and understands her better than anyone.
She is very skilled at song and dance, and her boyish short hair is her most attractive feature.
Because the Mermaid race has many voluptuous members, she's incredibly self-conscious about her flat chest, a trait which is quite rare among mermaids.

The matriarch of the Mermaids, a race whose population has been whittled down by the other races who trampled over them. Among the living mermaids, she is the only one approaching 300 years old, and her height is approximately the same as Yukikaze in her dragon form.

During the Pacific War, Mimori Ichirou, a petty officer and Zero fighter pilot, was about to launch a kamikaze attack on an enemy ship, when instead he finds himself crash-landing into an unfamiliar desert. As he wanders around lost, desperate for water, he is rescued by a strange princess who can transform into a dragon.

Ichirou has no idea where he is, or how to get back home - and even if he did make it back, an almost certain death would await him. Yet, the loyal soldier is determined to return to Japan no matter what it takes, in order to fulfill a promise he made...

The subordinate of Damon, an army officer of the Wisla Republic; she has been at his side even before she joined the military. Her petite frame and cute looks hide a much darker personality, but the moment she opens her mouth, her true evil nature rears its ugly head.

Miska tends to Damon's personal needs, but as everything she cooks turns into ash, which often leaves him disappointed. Her hobbies include sharpening the knives she's taken from her prey, as well as taking apart and putting together things that put up a good resistance to her blade.
Currently, she is entrusted with intelligence gathering. This is not because she is weak, but because she attacks indiscriminately, causing injury to her allies as well.
